lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr3Cu2Hg crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing six atoms and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Hg each adopt a tetrahedral environment with four Sr neighbors, while Sr is coordinated by four Cu and four Hg neighbors. The tetrahedral polyhedra exhibit corner-sharing between Cu and Hg tetrahedra, and between Hg and Sr polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing also observed between Cu tetrahedra and Sr coordination polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
